ZONINGLOTDEVELOPMENTAGREEMENT THIS ZONING LOT DEVELOPMENT AGREEMENT ("Agreement") made as of the/o#dayofJly municipal corporation organized pursuant to the laws of the State of New York, having its principal office at City Hall, New York, New York 10007 and 20 LAFAYETTE LLC ("Developer"), a New York State limited liability company having its principal place of business at 45 Main Street, Brooklyn,New York, 11201. WITNESSETH: WHEREAS, City is the owner of certain land, with improvements thereon, in the Cityof NewYork,Boroughof Manhattan,designated asLot103inBlock2110 ontheTaxMap of the City of NewYork and more particularly described on Exhibit A annexed hereto and made a part hereof (said land being herein called the “City Premises"” and said improvements being herein called the “City Improvements"); WHEREAS, simultaneous herewith, a portion of that certain land in the City of New York, Borough of Manhattan, designated as Lot 3 in Block 2110 on the Tax Map of the City, County and State of New York, as more particularly described on Exhibit B annexed hereto and made a part hereof (such land being herein called the “Developer Land") is being conveyed to Developer.The Developer contemplates constructing mixed-use building on the Developer Land, said building and improvement, together with any future replacements thereof permitted pursuant to the provisions of this Agreement, being herein called the “Building,” and the Developer Land and the Building being herein collectively called the “Developer Premises"; WHEREAS,the CityPremises,if any,as of the date of this Agreement, contains less “floor area", as defined in the Zoning Resolution (as hereinafter defined), than is now available for use on the City Premises pursuant to the Zoning Resolution, so that the Transferred Floor Area Development Rights (as hereinafter defined) are available for transfer to and utilization on the Developer Premises; WHEREAS, Developer desires to construct upon the Developer Land a mixed- use building(said construction by Developer and its contractors or sub-contractors being herein called the “Developer Work") and it is contemplated that such new Building will contain more floor area than is now available for use on the Developer Premises pursuant to the Zoning Resolution,and the partieshereto therefore desire to utilize theprocedure availablepursuant to Section 12-10 of the Zoning Resolution to treat the City Premises and the Developer Premises as a single zoning lot (the “Single Zoning Lot") so as to make available the Transferred Floor Area Development Rights (as hereinafter defined) for utilization in connection with the construction and maintenance of the Building, and, subject to the terms hereof, City is willing to make such Transferred Floor Area Development Rights available to Developer in perpetuity;
